tok.filter.search: Search tokens by name or owner
tok.notice.expiring: Showing tokens that expire within {days} days, expired ones included.
tok.table.caption: Access tokens
tok.col.name: Name
tok.empty.title: No tokens yet
tok.empty.hint: Create a token for a script, a CI job of one project, or an inbound federation peer. The secret is shown once, so store it when you create it.
tok.create.title: Create a token
tok.create.desc: Pick what the token is for first; the fields below follow.
tok.create.typeHint.personal: Acts as you. For your laptop or scripts.
tok.create.typeHint.project: For the CI of one project. Viewer or developer role.
tok.create.typeHint.federation: Inbound peer token for one repository. Administrators only.
tok.create.name: Name
tok.create.nameHint: What the token is used for, for example the CI job. Shown in the list and in audit entries.
tok.create.nameError.invalid: Use letters, digits, dots, underscores and dashes, starting with a letter or digit.
tok.create.scopesHint: Leave all unticked for full access: the token can do what you can do.
tok.create.noProject: You are not a member of any project that can have tokens.
tok.create.noRepo: No hosted repository has federation enabled. Enable it in the repository settings first.
tok.create.federationNote: Federation tokens never expire. Revoke the token when the peer is retired.
tok.create.noExpiryWarning: A token without an expiry stays valid until you revoke it.
tok.create.capHint: The project caps its tokens at {count} days.
tok.create.failed: The token could not be created.
tok.create.targetsFailed: Some choices could not be loaded. Close the drawer and try again.
tok.kind.access.hint: Can use the web UI API and the artifact endpoints with your permissions.
tok.kind.deploy.hint: Can push and pull artifacts but cannot call the management API.
tok.role.viewer.hint: Read access to the repositories of the project.
tok.role.developer.hint: Read and write access to the repositories of the project.
tok.revoke.title: Revoke this token?
tok.revoke.desc: {name} ({type} token, owned by {owner}) will be revoked. Anything using it, such as CI, stops authenticating immediately. This cannot be undone.
tok.revoke.failed: The token could not be revoked.
tok.reveal.title: Token {name}
tok.reveal.warning: Copy this token now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
tok.reveal.hint.personal: Use it as the password of your package manager or as a bearer token.
tok.reveal.hint.project: Put it in the secret store of your CI. It acts with the role you gave it.
tok.reveal.hint.federation: Give it to the peer instance that pulls this repository.
